mechanism: Both agents have additive effects on blood pressure reduction and heart rate lowering; guanfacine's alpha-2 agonist activity combined with propranolol's beta-blockade increases risk of hypotension and bradycardia, particularly on discontinuation of guanfacine.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; ensure gradual tapering of guanfacine to avoid rebound hypertension; adjust propranolol dose if needed based on clinical response.
